sensitivity_policy: Choose one flag probability q_j for EACH observed signal bin, independently constrained to0<=q_j<=1. Maximize conditional defect detection P(flag|defect)subject to P(flag|good)<=0.15. Randomization within a bin is explicitly allowed; do not restrict the search to deterministic thresholds or q in{0,1}.
cost_policy: Separately minimize unconditional expected deployment cost over ALL such bin-wise randomized policies, WITHOUT the sensitivity-policy false-alarm constraint. The cost is C_FP*(1-prevalence)*P(flag|good)+C_FN*prevalence*P(no flag|defect). This is a different objective on the same known class-conditional model. Compare the two optimal q vectors and report the cost of each under this same deployment population.
model_scope: Exact stipulated population probabilities of a controlled industrial defect-detection model, not estimated validation proportions or an empirical error-control guarantee. Source bin identities and probabilities remain paired.

provenance.data_origin: Project-constructed numerical studies with explicit physical/statistical working assumptions; not experimental performance claims.
